test.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_session_coverage.py tests/test_session_date_ledger.py; ruff check src/financial_brain/forward_edge/session_coverage.py src/financial_brain/forward_edge/session_ops.py tests/test_session_coverage.py tests/test_session_date_ledger.py

implemented: Frozen schedules hash expected exchange session IDs/dates, calendar version, and settlement deadlines.
Calendar validation distinguishes tradable sessions, special weekend sessions, weekends, and holidays.
Session-date ledger outcomes remain separate as CLOSED, NO_TRADE, INCOMPLETE, overdue MISSING, future PENDING, UNPLANNED, PLAN_MISMATCH, and UNQUALIFIED.
Unqualified, no-trade, completed, pending, and planned denominators are independently reported.
Human-readable and machine-readable report lists excluded non-trading and unscheduled tradable dates and carries a canonical report hash.
blockers: The frozen schedule is caller-supplied and not locked in an authoritative registry before session observations.
Daily scheduled report generation is not yet automated.
No prospective cohort period has validated daily denominators in operation.
